name: Two transfers for one unit at the same moment are both applied
title: SC-13-04-08 Two transfers for one unit at the same moment are both applied
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given the site is in state F5
When two webhooks of 1000.00 with different transaction ids arrive for unit "A-5" in parallel
Then unit "A-5" owes 2797.50
And both payments are listed and no allocation is counted twice
